partnership_announcements.description: Cellino and Polyphron announced a new strategic collaboration in which Cellino will produce iPSCs at scale and Polyphron will engineer them into functional tissues, creating end-to-end manufacturing for personalized tissue replacement.

press_references.value: Cellino, Karis Bio Partner on Autologous iPSC-Based Therapy for Cardiovascular Disease

partnership_announcements.description: Cellino, a biotechnology firm, has partnered with Karis Bio, a South Korean cell therapy company, to develop autologous iPSC-based therapy for cardiovascular diseases. This strategic collaboration aims to industrialize the first clinical-stage autologous iPSC therapy for peripheral and coronary artery diseases, leveraging Cellino's Nebula platform for scalable production.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Cellino is researching platforms and systems for automated cell culture, as described in 'Platforms and systems for automated cell culture,' which detail cell culture containers, imaging subsystems, and computing subsystems for processing cell cultures. Additionally, 'Systems and methods for cell manufacturing' outlines processes for culturing cells on specialized surfaces, while 'Microfluidic laser-activated intracellular delivery systems and methods' focuses on laser-based intracellular delivery. These efforts target automated, scalable cell therapy manufacturing.

about_short_description.short_description: Cellino is building an ultra-scalable biomanufacturing technology stack for personalized cell, tissue, and organ replacement therapies.

product.name: Nebula™ platform
product.description: A modular, cassette-based biomanufacturing system for scalable production of personalized regenerative cells and tissues.

product.name: AI-driven optical bioprocess
product.description: An image-guided, closed-loop bioprocess using AI to control cell manufacturing with minimal human variability.

product.name: Laser cell management
product.description: A laser-based technique that uses laser-generated bubbles to selectively remove unwanted cells and control cell density.

product.name: Cellinoverse
product.description: A digital simulation environment that models biomanufacturing behavior in silico for process development and optimization.

product.name: Deep Learning AI algorithms
product.description: AI algorithms that automate and standardize biomanufacturing processes to improve reproducibility and scalability.
